reviews.text: Cleo loves it! We've been letting her for years now and she loves it, so we're always calm and happy!
A great experience! Very professional! Our Kira feels at home there!!!!! Thank you very much Leo and Yolanda!!!

They are a 10, both Leo and Yolanda.
An exquisite treatment.
They took good care of my dog. Daily updates. I left the exact amount of food I had weighed out, and it was used as instructed.
Every time we drive past, Molly wants to go in. The doggy daycare is great, and she always finds a friend from the park. Leo loves dogs, and they're happy and very well cared for.

Our experience with our dog Axel has been truly wonderful. He was an older dog who needed a lot of care, and they adapted to his needs perfectly, looking after him and pampering him every time they looked after him, whether for a few hours or for full days. The service is very personal, friendly, and professional.

The best place for your dog, so they're never alone, whether for a few hours or longer periods. The care is exceptional, and it's clear the dogs are happy and well looked after. Lucas settled in quickly and feels right at home every time he goes; he's always so happy. He always comes back beaming, and there's no doubt he loves the place and everyone there. We have complete confidence in them and recommend them 100%!

We love Llar Canina!!!
We play with them and they take us for walks in the park!! 🥳👏🏼👏🏼🌿🌳
Long hours and super friendly service!! We recommend it 100% 🐶 …
Perfect place to leave your dog while you travel. They are given a great deal of care and exercise and you are updated each day with how they are doing. Will be returning!

I've been taking my dog ​​there for a few months now and I couldn't be happier.
He's so happy when he's there and I'm so relaxed.
They take care of him and treat him like he's their own.
Plus, they keep me updated when I write to them, and they send me photos and videos.
A top-notch place!!! 🔝🤍
The peace of mind of being able to leave your pet 🐕 knowing that they will be treated as if they were in their own home. …
Musclu, my Bernese Mountain Dog, loves staying at Llar Canina. Flexibility, love, and dedication to their work. Great job, team!

Great place, very well set up and organized. Very clean. Close to my home. Leo is a well-known person in the park and very friendly! It was my first time, but Coco was still looking for him when we left! Good sign!
Beautiful place! For us (who work long hours outside the home) it's a relief to know our dog is cared for and stimulated instead of being alone at home. He goes and comes back so happy!

It's so nice to have a trustworthy place to leave the dogs, especially when we travel, but also sometimes just for a few hours and then when you go to pick them up they don't want to leave 😂 That's a good sign! The place is fantastic and the people who run it are even better! Thank you for taking such good care of Maca and Gato, I recommend them 100%!

Great facilities, professionalism, and excellent service.
100% recommended!
